name: 83669 · Star, ID
findings: ZIP 83669 (Star) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83669 (Star) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 83669 (Star) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).
